title: Run the estate reconciliation loop unattended
goal: Observe the local and cloud AI estate on susi's own schedule - no command, no session - diff it against the declared desired state, and act within policy: warm or evict a model, start or drain a runtime, rotate away from a dead key, collect an orphaned resource. The loop resumes after a restart rather than restarting its work, and every pass is audited. This is the difference between a toolbox a user must drive and an OS that manages the estate: the mechanisms for inventory, plan and drift are already claimed (see the VC-201 LOCAL_HOSTING/CLOUD_HOSTING/CONFIGURATION vectors) - what is missing is the loop that runs without being asked.
